title: Tools Beyond the Shell
description: Past the shell, Codex's built-in tools search the live web (--search), read attached images (-i), generate images, and drive a browser or desktop -- all gated by stable feature flags.

steps.content: argv = [codex, --search, -i, error.png, "why does this login page loop?"]
steps.annotation: --search enables the native Responses web_search tool (no per-call approval); -i/--image attaches image files to the initial prompt.

steps.content: why does this login page loop? (see attached screenshot)
steps.annotation: The image is attached as input the model can see, not described in text; the same turn also carries live-web access.

steps.content: The screenshot shows a redirect to /auth. Let me check current docs and reproduce it.
steps.annotation: The model reads the attached image and plans against both the pixels and the repo.
With --search, the model calls the built-in web_search tool for live results instead of relying on training data.

steps.content: top hit: SameSite=Lax + cross-site POST drops the session cookie
steps.annotation: The web result is appended to the conversation like any tool result.

steps.content: browser_use: open http://localhost:3000/login, submit form, trace redirects
steps.annotation: The browser_use feature (stable/on) lets Codex drive a real browser to reproduce the loop, not just reason about it.
The browser trace confirms the redirect cycle the screenshot hinted at.

steps.content: Confirmed: the session cookie is dropped cross-site. I'll relax SameSite for the auth callback.
steps.annotation: Shell, web_search, image input, and browser all feed one reasoning loop.

steps.content: related stable flags: image_generation, computer_use (drive a desktop), browser_use_external / full_cdp_access
steps.annotation: These are built-in capabilities toggled by feature flags; `codex features list` shows each one's stage and effective state.

steps.content: Fixed and re-traced: 200 on the callback, no more loop.
steps.annotation: Codex's tool surface reaches well past the shell while staying the same agent loop.
